'''Galody and Tupit's home''' was a house owned by two [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] named [[Galody]] and [[Tupit]] on the edge of the [[Smuggler Outpost]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWG:NS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galody and Tupit's home was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The home was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:IG-88|"IG-88" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
